Definition: from the base of G2330; warmth:--heat.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, thérmē is the word for heat, warmth. In Acts 28:3, there came a viper out of the heat.
TheologicalSignificance: A viper driven out by the heat of Paul's fire reminds me that trouble can strike in the most ordinary moment, even while doing good.
